_comment: Phase 1: tiered scan cadence + check-list, data-driven. reports-common Tier enum + --tier CLI flag read this via build-reports.json:.tiers. `interval_secs` is the target cadence; `max_age_secs` is the staleness budget the renderer uses to mark a report STALE (R1) — usually a small multiple of the interval to tolerate one missed run. `checks[]` names the check groups a tier runs; the crate maps names to collectors. Cheaper tiers run more often; deeper tiers run rarely and only off the 1GB VMs.

t0._comment: Heartbeat — island liveness only. Cheapest: 1 TCP + 1 UDP per host. On-VM (health-agent), pushed to health_mesh.

t1._comment: Probe — public surface. No SSH. Runs on edge / GHA.

t2._comment: Deep — SSH into VMs for host/container metrics. GHA over WG.

t3._comment: Forensic — heavy log-mining + audits + scanners. Daily. GHA / oci-apps builder only, NEVER on 1GB VMs.
